card.name: The second 'as' in 'as often as'
card.fires_on: Mostly the word 'as' completing comparisons like 'as often as', 'as frequently as' and 'as long as' (also 'As little as') in dosing text. Weaker, scattered hits appear inside journal names and a few medical words.

modes.label: Comparative 'as ... as'
modes.description: The closing 'as' after an adverb such as often, frequently or long, giving a limit or range.
modes.example: treating as often<< as>> every 4 weeks

modes.label: Journal title parts
modes.description: Pieces of journal names or science words in reference lists, like Immunology or Human Genetics.

card.writes: It suppresses the Chinese comparative 'the more... the more' words (越, 越多, 越大), so it adds no clear English output.
card.plain: It lights up on the second 'as' in phrases like 'as often as' or 'as long as' when a dosing limit is given.
